slug: 2026-06-23 Bimonthly Update on Privacy in Africa (January & February 2026)

facts.fact: Tech Hive Advisory reports that South Africa's data protection authority (the Information Regulator) convened a stakeholder consultation on 18 February 2026 on a draft code of conduct for processing personal information at gated access points; the source does not name which stakeholders took part.
facts.system: Draft code of conduct for the processing of personal information at gated access points

note: South Africa's draft AI policy is only reported as due for 60 days of public comment after cabinet, which is future and gives no fact; other country items are not ZAF.
